The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Plane error in WHY; the narrative focuses on personal grievances rather than the strategic reality of the regional conflict.

This is a classic cycle of projection and pretext. By framing the opponent as 'scum,' the leadership justifies aggressive action, maintaining conflict rather than resolving it.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated diplomatic goals and ground-level strikes, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The conflict is self-reinforcing.

The Unavoidable Truth: Diplomacy has failed to contain the regional escalation.

The Unavoidable Lie: That this conflict can be resolved through aggressive rhetoric alone.
